lines: I guess the power's out.
Edna...
I'm having trouble with the Zom-B-Matic.
I need to shut down the power.
It'll be off for 5 or 6 minutes.
Don't worry my little Beauty Queen soon everything will be different.
Hey Ed!
The meteor wants to borrow your hamster and electric cattle prod.
Better watch it, Ed you're going to piss-off the meteor.
It already thinks you stole my purple card key.
I can't get to the meteor without it.
Shape up, kid!
I'm sorry my mad, insane plan...
...caused you so much trouble.
How can I ever repay you for your help?
Don't be a tuna head!
...cost your boyfriend his life.
How can I repay you for what I've done?
Hey! Wait, I could build a machine that...
...would bring him back to life!
But that's another story.
Ha, ha, ha!
Well, my dear. Hope you're having fun!
Within minutes it'll all be over.
You'll be hooked up to my machine...
...getting your pretty brains sucked out.
That's what she thinks!
Heh, heh, heh.
Oh no!
The pool is empty again!
We're going to have another meltdown!
How can I take over the world when I'm on a budget?
I always get stuck with cheap equipment.
Boy is the meteor going to be pissed.
TENTACLE! FRONT AAAND CENTER!
Quick! Go check out the reactor.
PURPLE TENTACLE!
Stop playing with the lab experiments.
Bring her, the machine is ready.
Oh great, someone shut the power off!
Not again!
Shh... I think I hear something!
Quiet! I think I hear someone upstairs!
PURPLE TENTACLE!
Go upstairs and check it out!
Ha, du machst wohl Witze. Ich bin Arzt, kein Zauberer!
Bei DER Schwere der Hirnverletzungen...
...reicht es höchstens noch für die eSports-Ecke.
